top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver allowed an infant to fall asleep in a restrictive device (swing) for approximately twelve minutes before removing the infant from the device and placing the infant in a crib.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4805(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found to be deficient as the slide exit use zone overlapped with nearby other equipment.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have form 2985 notarized.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Withholding Active Play (26 TAC §746.2805(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Active play is being withheld from children who misbehave in the classroom.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.
